title: On the Wasserstein barycenter of positive definite operators
summary: We extend the Bures-Wasserstein mean of positive definite matrices to the case of positive definite operators on a Hilbert space. This is done through its defining stationary point operator equation, coming from the gradient of the sum of squared Bures-Wasserstein distances of centered Gaussians represented by positive definite matrices. This gradient is shown to have a Fréchet derivative which induces a bounded linear operator on the space of Hilbert-Schmidt operators with strictly positive real spectrum.
